command: set -euo pipefail; SRC="$HOME/Desktop/kamienna110-map-150x150.svg"; JOB="$HOME/Desktop/kamienna110-map-150x150-kobra-job-20260929"; OUT="$HOME/Desktop/kamienna110-map-150x150-kobra.gcode"; PREVIEW="$HOME/Desktop/kamienna110-map-150x150-kobra-preview.svg"; REPORT="$HOME/Desktop/kamienna110-map-150x150-kobra-report.json"; test -s "$SRC"; test ! -e "$JOB"; cd projects/kobra2-neo; uv sync --frozen; uv run kobra-plot doctor; uv run kobra-plot prepare "$SRC" -o "$JOB"; test -s "$JOB/output.gcode"; test -s "$JOB/preview.svg"; test -s "$JOB/report.json"; cp "$JOB/output.gcode" "$OUT"; cp "$JOB/preview.svg" "$PREVIEW"; cp "$JOB/report.json" "$REPORT"; echo '=== FILES ==='; ls -lh "$OUT" "$PREVIEW" "$REPORT"; echo '=== REPORT SUMMARY ==='; python3 -c 'import json,pathlib; r=json.loads((pathlib.Path.home()/"Desktop/kamienna110-map-150x150-kobra-report.json").read_text()); [print(k, json.dumps(r[k], ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)) for k in ("source","geometry","gcode","safety","execution") if k in r]'; echo '=== GCODE SANITY ==='; head -8 "$OUT"; echo '...'; tail -8 "$OUT"; if grep -En '(^|[[:space:]])(G28|G91|M10[49]|M140|M190|M82|M83)([[:space:]]|$)|(^|[[:space:]])E[-+0-9.]' "$OUT"; then echo 'DISALLOWED_COMMAND_FOUND'; exit 22; else echo 'NO_DISALLOWED_COMMANDS'; fi; echo -n 'SHA256='; shasum -a 256 "$OUT" | awk '{print $1}'; echo PREPARE_MAP_DONE
